title: The Honest Fight

canonical_node.axiom: Every claim must survive hostile audit and public error correction; claims are only as strong as their ledger entry.
definitions: Ledger: a permanent public record of claims that were right, wrong, overstated, or derivation-owed.
Hostile audit: an adversarial review instructed to kill whatever it can, not a sympathetic review.
Derivation owed: a claim stands but the derivation is pending, not optional.
Overstated: a claim reduced to a weaker form because the original was not supported.
Kill condition: a stated condition that, if met, falsifies the claim.
derivation: The Master Equation as originally displayed was mathematically false; the veto architecture survives in repaired canonical form as chi = product of normalized sector scores.
The four forms (product, ratio, dynamic, field) survived both audit passes and are scoped as formal model forms, not operationally validated physics.

The Fruits from the Yukawa potential: seven of nine derive as properties of one equilibrium expanded around one minimum (Hessian); gentleness and self-control are control-theoretic add-ons; derivation owed.

The Trinity Chain: '1+1=3' and '1x1x1=1 proves three' are killed permanently; divine attributes read off EM waves are cut; the Maxwell coupling invariant is the strongest formal result, Lean 4 verified with zero sorry, but definition-ablation matrix is remaining work.

Consciousness chain: consciousness derived from chi-field equilibrium is overstated because a non-conscious scalar field satisfies all stated conditions; the internal-regress argument stands with two named holes.

General framework: information primacy survives all five elimination rounds; Shannon base layer structural role held; experimental correlations at 5.7-6.35 sigma are real but scoped as correlations within declared axioms, not independent confirmations.
The 7Q classifier is a universal elimination chain; every exit is a named worldview; the classifier names exits and keeps going.
Proposed experiments are not yet confirmation; each has a falsification condition.
canonical_node.action: Maintain a permanent public ledger of all claims, their audit dispositions, and corrections; apply the six generating axioms to every claim; run the audit standard protocol; use the 7Q classifier to classify any inquiry; publish all gaps and kills without mercy.
boundary: Does not operationally validate spiritual terms as physics.
Does not claim experimental correlations are causation or independent confirmations of the full framework.
Does not claim the Lean verification covers the physics-to-theology mapping.
Does not claim the bridge language (eta=grace, W=free will) is theorem.
Does not claim the consciousness chain is derived from chi-field equilibrium; it is a proposed substrate model with structural analogues.
Does not claim the 7Q classifier proves anything by itself; it is an elimination chain that names exits.
Does not claim the proposed experiments are confirmations; they are proposals with falsification conditions.
test: Check that every claim on any page has a corresponding ledger entry.
Check that every claim has a stated kill condition.
Check that corrections are printed where the claims were printed, with no silent edits.
Check that the audit standard protocol is followed: apparent objection surfaces, corpus search, structural test, disposition.
Check that the 7Q classifier is applied to any inquiry and that exits are named.
Check that the scope labels are applied: formal model forms, correlations within declared axioms, bridge language, placeholder C_W.

dg1_dependencies: The six generating axioms (meta-pattern recognition, structural isomorphism, mathematical formalization, falsifiability, hostile audit, public error correction).
The Ledger as a permanent record.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a self-correcting epistemological framework that classifies any claim via the 7Q elimination chain and maintains a public ledger of audit outcomes, enabling claims to be strengthened or killed based on hostile audit.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the surviving claims: information primacy, Shannon base layer, Maxwell coupling invariant (Lean verified), internal-regress argument, and the repaired Master Equation veto architecture.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the Ledger or the hostile audit axiom is removed, the framework loses its self-correction mechanism and claims revert to unverified assertions; the 7Q classifier without the audit standard becomes a mere taxonomy.
dg5_translation_registers: The Master Equation: chi = product of normalized sector scores.
The Shannon base layer: C_i = A_i * log2(1 + T_i / D_i).
The Maxwell coupling invariant: quaternion EM and Trinity relational structure pass the same gates.
The bridge language: eta = grace, W = free will (explicitly bridge language, not theorem).

classification.recommended_atom_action: preserve as a self-correcting framework; treat all specific claims as scoped and subject to ledger entries

overstatement_risks: The 7Q classifier is described as 'universal' and 'collapses all inquiry'  -  this is an overstatement unless proven.
The Maxwell coupling invariant is called 'the strongest formal result' but the definition-ablation matrix is incomplete.
The experimental correlations are real but scoped; risk of treating them as confirmations.
The consciousness chain is reduced but still may be seen as more than a substrate model.
The bridge language (eta=grace, W=free will) is explicitly bridge language, but risk of reification.
kill_conditions: If any claim on any page lacks a ledger entry, the framework's self-correction claim fails.
If the 7Q classifier fails to classify a known inquiry or an exit is not named, the universality claim fails.
If the Maxwell coupling invariant is found to have a counterexample in Lean, the strongest formal result fails.
If the proposed experiments return null results, the corresponding hypotheses are falsified.
If the definition-ablation matrix for the Maxwell coupling invariant is never completed, the claim remains incomplete.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the Maxwell coupling invariant and the Master Equation veto architecture in Lean, and complete the definition-ablation matrix.

plain_summary: This document is a self-audit ledger that records what claims survived hostile review, which were killed, and which were reduced. It establishes six generating axioms for claim production and a 7Q classifier for universal inquiry. It explicitly concedes gaps and scopes. The framework is coherent as a self-correcting epistemology, but many specific claims are scoped or derivation-owed.
